weather: Rainy and cold in Longmeadow today — high of 42°F with NE winds 10–15 mph and a 90% chance of rain. Rain clears early, but it’s a stay-inside-and-execute kind of morning.
focus: Reply to Christian at roofwithhtx.com — today or cut it. His market objection is now 6+ days old. You’ve let it age past useful. Write one direct reply: here’s a specific result you’d get, here’s what it costs, here’s the link. If he ghosts after that, suppress and move on. Letting objections sit is not a strategy — it’s avoidance.

Build your one-page offer doc. You’re having sales conversations without a written offer — that’s why close rates are soft. Spend 45 minutes today building a dead-simple doc: what you do, what results clients get, specific CPL/ROI numbers, and price. You reference it in calls, paste it in DMs, and send it after warm intros. This is the single most reusable asset you don’t have yet.

Record a 60-second Loom for one warm lead. Text converts at X. Personal video converts at 3–5X. Pick one person from your outreach who replied but hasn’t booked — name them in the video, reference their specific situation, drop a calendar link. Under 90 seconds. This one tactic separates amateur outreach from real operators.

Request one testimonial today. A direct ask to a current or past client: "Hey, would you write me 2–3 sentences on what working together has been like? I’m putting together a case study." You’ve got zero public social proof right now and that’s silently killing warm leads who check you out. One ask takes 2 minutes.

Do a cold outreach sequencing review. Pull the last 7 days of Instantly sends. Look at reply rates by subject line variant, check for any sequences that went quiet, and identify the best-performing angle. If one subject line is outperforming by more than 50%, double down on it for this week’s new sends. Data drives the funnel — you can’t improve what you don’t look at.
